claims.claim_atom: The Source Data file (Source_Data_1.xlsx, sheet 'Fig 4b') contains n=21 individual animal TNF-a measurements for the LPS group at 8 hours (rows B3:B23, confirmed by the explicit n-declaration at B26=21) and n=22 measurements for the LPS group at 20 hours (rows J3:J24, confirmed at J26=22). The same layout applies to all five cytokines in the sheet (TNF-a, IL-6, IFN-g, MCP-1, IL-10), all sharing the same n counts per group. The published Figure 4b, however, depicted fewer individual data points per group than these Source Data row counts — an omission confirmed by Nature Communications publisher correction DOI 10.1038/s41467-023-42294-3, which explicitly states: 'In Figure 4, panel b incorrectly omitted a complete description of p-values, and data points were missing to reflect the raw data provided in the Source Data file.' This is a figure_vs_sourcedata_count_mismatch: the figure's scatter-plot point counts are lower than the Source Data row counts. This error is undetectable by automated detectors that operate on the Source Data file alone: (1) duplicate-col detector scans for columns that are byte-identical or differ by a constant offset — but the Source Data is internally self-consistent (all 21/22 rows are present and distinct); (2) fixed-offset detector checks for column-to-column constant differences in expression matrices — irrelevant here since the discrepancy is an absence of rows in the FIGURE, not a numerical pattern within the file; (3) paired-ratio detector looks for proportional relationships between data columns — again the file is internally clean. Detection requires comparing the figure's visible data-point count to the Source Data row count, an operation that spans a visual/graphical artifact (the figure) and a tabular file — it cannot be reduced to numerical analysis of the file alone.
claims._adjudication: 不一致(inconsistent): Source Data 'Fig 4b' シートにはLPS 8h群のTNF-a個体値が21行(B3:B23)、LPS 20h群が22行(J3:J24)存在し、B26=21、J26=22の明示的n宣言とも一致する。全5サイトカイン(TNF-a/IL-6/IFN-g/MCP-1/IL-10)がこのn数を共有する。しかし発表図Fig 4bではこれより少ない数の個体データ点しか描画されておらず、Nature Communications publisher correction (DOI:10.1038/s41467-023-42294-3)が『data points were missing to reflect the raw data provided in the Source Data file』と明示的に認定。B3検出器(duplicate-col/fixed-offset/paired-ratio)はSource Dataファイル内の数値パターンを探すが、このエラーはファイル内には存在しない(ファイル自体は正しい)。不在型エラーは図の点数とファイルの行数を比較して初めて発見される。

claims.claim_atom: The CTRL group at 8 hours has exactly 9 individual animal TNF-a measurements in the Source Data (cells G3:G11 = [2.26, 2.80, 1.99, 1.09, 1.71, 0.67, 2.04, 1.93, 0.00]), which is internally consistent with the explicit n-declaration at G26=9. These 9 values represent the vehicle-control animals in the LPS sepsis model at the 8-hour time point. Cell G11=0.00 (the minimum, representing an animal with undetectable TNF-a at 8h) is followed by no further non-null values in column G before the n-row at row 26, confirming that G3:G11 exhausts the CTRL 8h dataset. The Source Data is internally self-consistent for this group: stated n matches actual row count.
claims._adjudication: 合法子断言(consistent): CTRL 8h群のn宣言(G26=9)は実際のデータ行数(G3:G11の9値)と完全に一致する。このグループは更正通知でも言及されておらず、Source Data内部も整合。最小値G11=0(LPS未投与コントロールで検出限界以下)は生物学的に妥当。Source Dataファイルの内部整合性を確認する clean claim として機能する。

claims.claim_atom: The LPS 20h group in the Source Data contains exactly 22 individual animal TNF-a measurements (J3:J24), which matches the n-declaration at J26=22. The final value in this 20-hour LPS series is J24=407.39 pg/mL (the 22nd animal), after which cell J25 is empty and J26 holds the n-count. This n=22 is the largest animal group in the entire Fig 4b Source Data, notably larger than the corresponding 8h LPS group (B26=21), consistent with the experimental design of a multi-cohort in vivo study where animals accumulate across independent experiments. The LPS 20h group also exceeds the LPS+100ug/mL sHVF18 20h group (L26=22), which shares the same n at 20h but had only n=11 at 8h (D26=11), reflecting incomplete enrollment at the earlier time point. All these within-file n-value relationships are internally consistent in the Source Data.
claims._adjudication: 合法子断言(consistent): LPS 20h群のn宣言(J26=22)は実際のデータ行数(J3:J24の22値)と完全に一致する。最終値J24=407.39 pg/mLの後にJ25が空白でJ26がn宣言という構造も確認。8h LPS(n=21)より20h LPS(n=22)が多い点はmulti-cohort多段階エンロールメントとして生物学的に妥当。Source Data内部整合性確認のclean claim。

metadata._grounding_summary: Source_Data_1.xlsx の'Fig 4b'シートを直接パース核実。TNF-a/IL-6/IFN-g/MCP-1/IL-10 の5サイトカイン×2タイムポイント(8h/20h)×6処理群のデータを確認。LPS 8h群: B3:B23に21個の非NULL TNF-a値(B26=21と合致); LPS 20h群: J3:J24に22個の非NULL TNF-a値(J26=22と合致)。他群も同様にn宣言と行数が一致。更正DOI 10.1038/s41467-023-42294-3で図の不足点を著者/出版社が認定。
metadata._detector_note: figure_vs_sourcedata_count_mismatch はB3検出器(duplicate-col/fixed-offset/paired-ratio)の適用対象外: これらの検出器はすべてSource Dataファイル内の数値列間パターンを探索するが、本エラーはファイル内には存在しない(Source Dataは完全かつ正しい)。不在型エラー(図に描かれるべき点が欠如)はファイル内数値列をスキャンしても発見できない。発見には図の点数と対応するSource Data行数の比較が必要。
